note: Each gate fires once on this tree and nothing else does. fixed = no finding of that gate on that file after Canon's run; in Inbox (only where inbox is true) = a retirement of one of the finding's rules waits in the Inbox.

contradiction.fix: retire superseded rule 76b5ab29; the retirement waits in the Inbox

core-budget.fix: reword the longest core rules shorter until every core rule fits the index

broken-link.fix: unlink gotchas/quillbar-legacy.md, or link to the file that holds those rules

orphan.fix: describe the file with a read-when line, or link to it from a related topic

duplicate.fix: retire one of the two near-identical rules; the retirement waits in the Inbox

oversized.fix: split the 26 rules into topic files of 25 or fewer, each described

stale.fix: merge the file into gotchas/brindle.md; a describe alone leaves the finding, since lint reads only the last-read dates
